name: Sea Serpent
description: (Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)You are a Sea Serpent or Hybrid, a true apex predator of the seas. You can unleash your Sea Serpent characteristics as a Hybrid form or full Sea Serpent size. You also gain greatly superhuman physical abilities and grow empowered when wet or underwater. All Water-based abilities cost less energy and gain potency, but drying out drastically reduces all your stats.
